pure-announcement.rationale: It is a step-by-step integration tutorial, not a launch, release note, or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concepts are all MCP-, OSV-, and SIEM-related; no existing concept covers desktop app licensing or license-key validation.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every claim is a reproducible code path against documented public API endpoints a reader can execute.

durability.rationale: The workflow is expressed entirely in Keyforge endpoint URLs, SDK function names, and its current payment-provider list (Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, Polar) - a vendor feature surface that will drift, leaving only a thin generic activate/validate/offline-JWT skeleton.

actionability.rationale: The steps are product-only - create a Keyforge product, call Keyforge activate/validate, enable Keyforge tokens - and do not transfer to anyone not adopting that specific service.

atomicity.rationale: It describes a single linear workflow - activate a key per device, validate on launch, verify a signed token offline, auto-issue keys on purchase - statable in one paragraph.
